title: Works but.....
text: Works but...... It's a lid, it lids. But it is hard to keep the rubber piece for the straw down when you are using it and it tends to pop up when you open it making it hard to use as it is in the way and pokes you in the eye.

product_metadata.title: Docik 20 oz Tumbler Lids for Yeti 20oz Tumbler Yeti 10oz Lowball Yeti 10oz Mug and Yeti 16oz Pint, Spill Proof Splash Resistant Flip Lid, BPA-Free, 2 Pack (Black)
features: Excellent Compatibility - our 20oz lid fits the tumblers with 3.2" inner neck diameter. Specially designed for Docik 20oz Tumbler, Yeti 20oz Tumbler, Yeti 10oz Lowball, Yeti 10oz Mug and Yeti 16oz Pint

BPA Free Material - each Docik leak proof lid is made strictly from food grade crystal clear AS plastic which is durable, shatter resistant and BPA free. It is safe to touch your drink directly. Easy to clean, hand wash recommended
Unique Rubber Air Hole - when filling with a hot drink, open it to equalise air pressure inside and outside your coffee tumbler mug to prevent hot steam from pushing out the lid
No Nose Touching - the black plastic flip-top can be rotated up to 160 degrees so it won't touch your nose when you drink. Docik lid allows you to drink, sip or gulp, straws friendly
Excellent Sealing - durable and resilient black silicone gasket around the base of the lid to help seal your travel mug tightly and prevent leaks
